test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given arrangement carefully and answer the question that follows.

(Left) £ & 6 @ 4 f 2 4 % 1 3 ^ 3 ¥ @ 8 8 % 7 (Right)

How many such symbols are there in the above arrangement each of which is immediately followed by a number and immediately preceded by a symbol?
solution:
Given: (Left) £ & 6 @ 4 f 2 4 % 1 3 ^ 3 ¥ @ 8 8 % 7 (Right)

Symbols immediately followed by a number and immediately preceded by a symbol:

Needed pattern: **Symbol - Symbol - Number**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6001c64ae2a305bb96ffa358eaf52b83b7eb12dade0b61536096481a63cdd63.png] 

Thus, there are **two **such pairs:

 
• £ & 6
 
• ¥ @ 8

​Hence, the correct answer is **Option (4).** 

14
